items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yes. Baby Lovett and I would see eye-to-eye on a lot of different subjects and we'd talk to other guys around there

ctx.x: I think it's because of all the spooks laying around, getting ready to have a ball by themselves, you know and all the famous bands would come to -- that's when I first met Charlie Parker. was Jay McShann The band was there in Kansas City as well as our band, Harlan Leonard, there was Tommy Douglas, clarinet player. He had a group there.

I met Baby Lovett there, he was playing at this club with -- I can't recall the name -- [Lee] Julia -- I can't recall her name, but she was famous, too and Baby Lovett was the greatest dresser, one guy I'll never forget because he always dressed -- light suits, light hat, beautiful shoes, he would stand in front of the poolroom there on the Cut, they called it the Cut, 18th and Vine.
